agyos_skill.intent: Use when the user is unsure which skill to use or where to start. Interviews the user with targeted questions and recommends the best skill(s) from the installed library for their goal.
agyos_skill.instructions: Use this skill when: - The user says "I don't know where to start" or "which skill should I use" - The user has a vague goal without a clear method - The user asks "what should I use for..." or "I'm not sure how to approach this" - The user is new to the skill library and needs guidance Help users who are unsure of what they want to do or which skill to use. Interview them with a short structured conversation, then recommend the most relevant skill(s) from the installed library — with a clear explanation of why each skill fits and exactly how to invoke it. Respond warmly and tell the user you'll ask a few quick questions to find the right skill for them. Do NOT suggest any skills yet. Example opener: > "No problem — let me ask you a few quick questions so I can point you to > exactly the right skill." Ask only what you need. If an earlier answer makes a later question irrelevant, skip it. **Q1 — What is the broad area of the task?** Present these as numbered options: 1. Building / coding something (app, feature, component, script) 2. Fixing or debugging something that's broken 3. Security, pentesting, or vulnerability assessment 4. AI agents, LLMs, or automation pipelines 5. Marketing, SEO, content, or growth 6. DevOps, infrastructure, deployment, or git 7. Design, UI/UX, or creative output
